consequences: The short link stops redirecting immediately; printed copies stop working.
Its click history is archived and no longer shown.
It's removed from campaigns and bio pages; campaigns left empty are deleted.
An attached QR code stays, but no longer points at this link.

utm.deleteConsequence: This variant is removed from the saved list. Previously shared URLs keep redirecting and their analytics remain available.
utm.deleteCampaignConsequence: If this was the link’s last variant in a campaign, the link leaves that campaign. Empty campaigns are deleted.

utm.defaultsHint: Choose a saved campaign to see its defaults. You can also enter your own values.
